method: Analysis of frozen video descriptions and linked publisher README files. Full video content, installation and malware checks are unverified. Linkage is not an endorsement.

records.title: Academic Research Skills: A Specialist Agent Team For Serious Research
records.finding: Literature review skill suite. Index as a research workflow. Check citations and study eligibility independently before using a generated synthesis.

records.title: Planning With Files: Stop AI Agents Losing Context
records.finding: File-backed planning skill. A handoff can recover decisions from the plan, findings and progress files when the next session has access to the same files.

records.title: shots belongs on your radar
records.finding: Screenshot generation skill. Requires app metadata and actual app screenshots. Generated promotional images still need human review against the product.

records.title: xcodebuild.nvim belongs on your radar
records.finding: Neovim front end for Apple builds, tests and debugging. Catalog as developer tooling for an Apple project, rather than a general-purpose agent skill.

records.title: mnemory belongs on your radar
records.finding: Self-hosted memory service combining extracted facts and detailed artifacts. Review retention semantics before storing personal material; upstream distinguishes ordinary deletion from verified erasure.

records.title: Awesome Claude Code: A Curated Directory For Stronger AI Coding Workflows
records.finding: Directory of third-party Claude Code resources. Track as a discovery source and verify each downstream author separately.

records.title: This Repo Makes Your AI Write Less Code (ponytail)
records.finding: Coding instruction skill encouraging simpler implementations and native features. Evaluate its effects on the target repository rather than importing upstream benchmark gains.

records.title: Translate Books With LLMs: Keep Every Chapter And Format
records.finding: Document translation application with chunked processing across multiple formats. Test glossary consistency and layout on a representative file before a full translation.

records.title: Microsoft SkillOpt: make AI agents smarter — without training the model #anthropic #aicoding #ainews
records.finding: Optimization framework for agent skill instructions with fixed model weights. Record skill version and held-out task results when comparing changes; video benchmark numbers were not reproduced.

records.title: gitglimpse belongs on your radar
records.finding: Git-history CLI that groups commits into task summaries and structured output. Useful for drafting handoffs; its view is limited to recorded history.
